summary: Max Verstappen won the Belgian Grand Prix from P6 on the grid, 22.3s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Esteban Ocon made the biggest climb, from P14 to P8.
There were 37 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 125 points over Sergio Perez.
